### Pray to the Lord of the Harvest
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/pray-lord-harvest/
Passage: Matthew 9:37-38
Points:
- Jesus responds to the shortage of harvest workers with a command to pray first rather than rush into action.
- Praying for laborers and the lost aligns our hearts with God's desire for people to be saved.
- Faithful evangelistic intercession can be cultivated through deliberate practices like personal prayer cards and missionary calendars.
- Prayer remains the most vital and universally accessible gospel work available to every believer.

### Is There Room for Me?
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/is-there-room-for-me-encouragement-for-today-april-20-2015.html
Passage: Matthew 9:37-38
Points:
- Insecurity and comparison often deceive believers into thinking all ministry roles are already taken.
- The harvest field is vast, and God does not operate under a mindset of scarce opportunity.
- Rather than feeling threatened by others' gifts, Christians should celebrate and support fellow laborers.
- Jesus invites each person into the field while calling us to pray for even more workers to join.
